phases.title: Preserve and specify
exitCriteria: Inventory reviewed prototype source and provenance
Choose code license and audit redistribution rights
Freeze contract/sampling fixtures and supported/lab scope

phases.title: Package spine
exitCriteria: Extract headless ESM core with public declarations
Install actual tarballs in clean vanilla, Vite and SSR consumers
Prove no browser globals or authoring dependencies in core imports

phases.title: Vertical component
exitCriteria: Import and mount an accessible image-surface recipe
Human, agent and peer invoke the same receive contract
Test target commit versus visual settlement, cancellation and resource disposal
Measure browser/device workload and bundle budgets

phases.title: Authoring and source imports
exitCriteria: Compile exact source with diagnostics and provenance
Version source and implement plan/apply import and three-way upgrade conflicts
Test crash recovery, dedupe and stale revision preservation
Receiver-side capability checks and canonical root/symlink revalidation protect the first writes
Immutable component version save is distinct from project source commit; import executes no scripts

phases.title: Studio and agent integrations
exitCriteria: Build project-centric source/preview/inspector/Designer workspace
Extend the existing authorized semantic service through adapter parity tests
Ship thin Hermes and MCP adapters with parity tests
Validate managed install/update/rollback/uninstall and provider preservation

phases.title: Beta and release
exitCriteria: Curate five recipes and five-minute integration docs
Pass packed-artifact consumer, lifecycle, browser, accessibility and security gates
Complete notices, compatibility, changelog, provenance and support policy
Optional flow remains beta unless its arrival/commit gates pass

releaseClaim: No production library implemented by this planning foundation
